say:7:1422919108:1.text: But you'll need something better, stronger for the Fish King, especially since you're not exactly built for physical strength.
say:7:1422919108:1.source_cn: 但要想钓上鱼王，它的韧性和你的力气都不足以与鱼王的力量...

say:8:1422919109:1.text: How about I upgrade it for you? I can make you a mechanical-powered rod, give you more power to reel in those big ones. What do you think?
say:8:1422919109:1.source_cn: 我可以帮你改装一下，做根机械动力鱼竿，钓起鱼来更有劲，...

say:9:1422919110:1.text: Yeah, but this rod cost me three thousand gold!
say:9:1422919110:1.source_cn: 可以是可以……但是、但是这根鱼竿可是花了我三千金币啊！

choice_prompt:10:1422919110.text: Yeah, but this rod cost me three thousand gold!
choice_prompt:10:1422919110.source_cn: 可以是可以……但是、但是这根鱼竿可是花了我三千金币啊！

say:11:1422919111:1.text: Alright, be honest. What else have you bought since you started fishing?
say:11:1422919111:1.source_cn: ……！你都跟我讲讲，你入坑钓鱼以来，都买过些什么东西……

say:12:1422919112:1.text: Alright, alright, I'll start from the beginning...

narration:13:1422919113:0.text: Adelina starts telling Manya everything about her fishing adventures, and it's enough to write a whole "Beginner's Guide to Avoiding Fishing Scams"...
narration:13:1422919113:0.source_cn: 阿黛琳从头讲起了她入坑钓鱼以来的种种经历，而这些天真的...

say:15:1422919103:1.text: Yeah, I haven't been scammed that many times, so I don't exactly have a ton of lessons to share...
say:15:1422919103:1.source_cn: 骗术这块确实罗列得有些简单，毕竟我没被骗过那么多次嘛……
say:15:1422919103:1.male: Yeah, I haven't been scammed that many times, so I don't exactly have a ton of lessons to share...
say:15:1422919103:1.female: Yeah, I haven't been scammed that many times, so I don't exactly have a ton of lessons to share...

say:16:1422919104:1.text: But this should be enough to warn newbies.
say:16:1422919104:1.source_cn: 只是提醒新手要提高警惕的话应该够了。
say:16:1422919104:1.male: But this should be enough to warn newbies.
say:16:1422919104:1.female: But this should be enough to warn newbies.

choice:2:1:2.text: Could use a bit more detail.
choice:2:1:2.male: Could use a bit more detail.
choice:2:1:2.female: Could use a bit more detail.

cinematic_dialogue:2:1422908001:.text: Here to fish? Pay the entry fee.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1422908001:.source_cn: 来钓鱼的吗？交下入场费

say:4:1422909001:0.text: This spot's mine now. I leased the whole area. One thousand gold to cast a line.
say:4:1422909001:0.source_cn: 这片钓场被我承包啦，要钓鱼的话，先交入场费。每人一千金币。

say:5:1422909002:1.text: Entry fee? Are you kidding me? I've been fishing for years and never heard of such nonsense.
say:5:1422909002:1.source_cn: 入场费？什么鬼东西。我玛尼娅钓了这么多年鱼，从来没听说...

say:6:1422909003:0.text: That's just because you've only ever fished in puddles! This here's the Fish King's turf—top-tier waters. If you want to cast a line, you've got to pay up like everyone else.
say:6:1422909003:0.source_cn: 那是你之前钓鱼的地方都不上档次！我这里可是经过精心修缮...

say:7:1422909004:0.text: You claim you leased this area with those crates on shore? I never even stepped on them. I came in by boat, didn't cross your "border", so I don't owe you anything.
say:7:1422909004:0.source_cn: 你说的精心修缮，是指那几个挡路的破箱子？我可是一点都没...

say:8:1422909005:0.text: A thousand gold per person? You're better off just mugging people—it's faster.
say:8:1422909005:0.source_cn: 竟然还敢开价一千金币一个人……你想赚钱的话，还是抢劫更快点。

say:9:1422909006:0.text: Enough talk! You paying or not? 'Cause if you're not, I won't be so polite.
say:9:1422909006:0.source_cn: 真是强词夺理！你交不交？不交可别怪我不客气了。

say:10:1422909007:0.text: Oh, I'd love to see you try. I'll grab you by the collar and spin you like a top.
say:10:1422909007:0.source_cn: 我倒要看看你怎么对我不客气，难道你想试试我这胳膊抡起你...

narration:13:1422909009:0.text: Duram takes off at a light jog.

say:15:1422909010:0.text: Unbelievable. That dwarf barges into someone else's fishing spot and expects a free ride?
say:15:1422909010:0.source_cn: 真是蛮横无理的矮人……想在钓场钓鱼，却不愿意付钱……

say:16:1422909011:0.text: Hey, you two, don't think I can't hear you whispering back there.
say:16:1422909011:0.source_cn: 嘿，你们这两个交了钱的冤大头，可别把我当聋子。
say:16:1422909011:0.male: Hey, you two, don't think I can't hear you whispering back there.
say:16:1422909011:0.female: Hey, you two, don't think I can't hear you whispering back there.

say:17:1422909012:0.text: That crook could sell you piece by piece and you'd still help him bag the gold.
say:17:1422909012:0.source_cn: 依我看，那个所谓的钓场老板把你从头到脚卖掉，你还要帮他...

say:18:1422909013:0.text: I'll be just fine, thanks. Duram's not about to sell me off. You, on the other hand, just drove away the owner of this place. What are you gonna do next, burn the whole lake?
say:18:1422909013:0.source_cn: 你不必替我担心，杜兰姆不会卖掉我。反倒是你，把钓场的管...

say:19:1422909014:0.text: What I'm gonna do is catch the <style="highlight">rockguana</style>. Unlike you, princess—hauling around fancy gear like it's a fashion show—I actually know what I'm fishing for. I bet you don't even know what the Fish King is!
say:19:1422909014:0.source_cn: 下一步当然是钓<style=highlight>古岩鬣...

say:20:1422909015:1.text: Of course I know the rockguana's the Fish King! That's literally why I'm here!
say:20:1422909015:1.source_cn: 我当然知道古岩鬣蜥是鱼王！我就是为了钓上鱼王而来的！

say:21:1422909016:1.text: Bold words for someone still wet behind the ears...

say:22:1422909017:1.text: If you're so sure you're better than me, let's settle it—first one to catch the Fish King wins. I wanna see that smug face when I pull it up!
say:22:1422909017:1.source_cn: 你既然觉得你比我厉害这么多，我们就来比比谁先钓上鱼王！...

say:23:1422909018:0.text: You think I'm scared of some rookie who probably tangled her rod on the walk over? Let's see what you've got.
say:23:1422909018:0.source_cn: 我可不会怕你一个竿都没握熟的新手，让我看看你的本事吧。

say:24:1422909019:0.text: Come on, let's move down the shore. I don't want her bad attitude scaring off the fish!
say:24:1422909019:0.source_cn: 走，我们去那边钓鱼，离她远点！
say:24:1422909019:0.male: Come on, let's move down the shore. I don't want her bad attitude scaring off the fish!
say:24:1422909019:0.female: Come on, let's move down the shore. I don't want her bad attitude scaring off the fish!

narration:26:14022923:0.text: As you're about to cast your line, a dwarf arrives at the fishing spot by boat. Duram walks over and demands an entry fee.
narration:26:14022923:0.source_cn: 你们正打算钓鱼时，一个矮人坐着船来到了钓场。杜兰姆迎上...
narration:26:14022923:0.male: As you're about to cast your line, a dwarf arrives at the fishing spot by boat. Duram walks over and demands an entry fee.
narration:26:14022923:0.female: As you're about to cast your line, a dwarf arrives at the fishing spot by boat. Duram walks over and demands an entry fee.

narration:4:1422917001:0.text: The mysterious fish on the line is incredibly strong. Adelina pulls with everything she's got, but the line snaps, and the fish vanishes into the depths like it was never there...
narration:4:1422917001:0.source_cn: 上钩的神秘大鱼力气惊人，阿黛琳奋力拉扯，然而鱼线却不堪...

say:6:1422917002:0.text: Was that the Fish King? Ugh! I should've used a stronger line!
say:6:1422917002:0.source_cn: 刚刚上钩的是鱼王吗？好可惜！都怪我，应该换更结实的鱼线的！

say:7:1422917003:0.text: That size and power? It's gotta be! Looks like I really underestimated you.
say:7:1422917003:0.source_cn: 这个体型和力量，十有八九是了！鱼王竟然咬了你的钩，看来...

say:8:1422917004:0.text: So Duram really was scamming us? That shrimp bait didn't catch anything decent!
say:8:1422917004:0.source_cn: 所以那个杜兰姆真的是在骗人吗……他卖给我的赤虾饵不光鱼...

say:9:1422917005:0.text: Finally catching on, huh? Maybe you're not so hopeless, after all.
say:9:1422917005:0.source_cn: 总算开始怀疑了？看来你还没有笨得彻底嘛。

say:10:1422917006:0.text: That bait you were using probably has that awful scale powder in it. Toss them in the water, and the fish won't even come near! Only the really desperate ones will take a bite.
say:10:1422917006:0.source_cn: 那些鱼饵里八成掺了气味呛鼻的滑鳞粉，一旦放入水中，周围...

say:11:1422917007:0.text: Ew, now that you mention it, the bait does smell nasty. Like someone dunked a sock in fish guts.
say:11:1422917007:0.source_cn: 我闻闻！真的有一股呛鼻的味道！放进水里后，这股味道更加...

say:12:1422917008:0.text: Classic trick. The bad bait keeps the fish away, and you think you just didn't use enough—so you buy more. Easy money for scammers.
say:12:1422917008:0.source_cn: 这样钓不上鱼来的你才会怀疑是不是投的饵不够多，进而找他...

say:13:1422917009:0.text: How could he do this to me? I actually thought we were friends! I'm gonna give him a piece of my mind!
say:13:1422917009:0.source_cn: 杜兰姆怎么能这样！我还以为他真的把我当朋友，我要去找他算账！

narration:16:1422917011:0.text: Duram shows up, fuming, with a couple of beefy dwarves in tow. Looks like he's got some muscle this time.
narration:16:1422917011:0.source_cn: 杜兰姆气冲冲地出现了，身后还跟着几个强壮的矮人打手，看...

say:18:1422917012:0.text: Alright, boys! That's the one who tried to fish in my spot without paying. Time to show her how we do things around here!
say:18:1422917012:0.source_cn: 兄弟们，就是那个女矮人闯进我的钓场钓鱼，连一分钱都不掏...

say:21:1422917013:0.text: So you think you can fish here for free?

say:22:1422917014:0.source_cn: 把你身上的钱都掏出来！

say:26:1422917016:0.text: Hey! You can't just go around hitting people! Stop it!
say:26:1422917016:0.source_cn: 你们、你们怎么能打人呢？住手！

narration:28:14022929:0.text: After tossing the mechanical parts into the lake, you spot something moving beneath the surface—a mysterious giant fish is taking the bait.
narration:28:14022929:0.source_cn: 你们把机械部件放入湖中，不一会儿，湖里有了动静，一只神...
narration:28:14022929:0.male: After tossing the mechanical parts into the lake, you spot something moving beneath the surface—a mysterious giant fish is taking the bait.
narration:28:14022929:0.female: After tossing the mechanical parts into the lake, you spot something moving beneath the surface—a mysterious giant fish is taking the bait.
